name: Törnsfall - Almvik - Hallingeberg, Tjustleden etapp 5
description: Törnsfall / Mösjön to Hallingeberg / Källtorp. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Official Section 5 GPX/API starts at/near the Mösjön shelter, about 90.9 m from the official Section 4 Törnsfall endpoint/OSM guidepost. OSM Etapp 5 starts at the Section 4 endpoint.
Naturkartan API reports publish_gpx=false for site 21837, but the direct .gpx endpoint works and official pages expose the route.
OSM relation 3199981 is older, about 0.75 km longer than official GPX/API, and diverges by hundreds of meters in the early/mid route.
Naturkartan/Västervik Outdoor use Blå - medel, while Västervik municipality text describes kuperade partier. Pacer labels the route hard.
2026 Tjust practical advice says water can be obtained at/near Mösjön, but OSM toilet object has drinking_water=no and no exact water source was identified.
Official text uses Källtorp/Källtorpsstugan/undantagsstugan Källtorp; OSM uses Undantagsstugan Källstorp; Naturkartan slug includes hallingeberg-svedstugan.

facilities.name: Mjösjön / Törnsfall shelter
facilities.coordinateSource: Naturkartan API site 28850; OSM node 2453739049 corroborates nearby at 57.8078783,16.4565075.
facilities.description: Timber overnight wind shelter at the Section 5 start near Mösjön, northwest of Törnsfalls church. Naturkartan slug/name uses Törnsvall, likely typo for Törnsfall.

facilities.name: Mjösjön / Törnsfall dry toilet
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM node 4164025675; official sources confirm TC at start.
facilities.description: Dry toilet at the Section 5 start shelter area. OSM has drinking_water=no. Do not infer potable water from this toilet object.

facilities.name: Borgareberget / Utsikt Tjustleden etapp 5
facilities.description: Viewpoint near Borgareberget. Official text describes Borgareberget as a hillfort area with good views. Published Naturkartan name is generic. Avoid importing separate unpublished Borgareberget site unless verified.

facilities.name: Norra Hällsjön - Skönja, ArkNat
facilities.coordinateSource: Naturkartan API site 74406; OSM node 11382437299 corroborates nearby at 57.8476744,16.3958287.
facilities.description: Architect-designed ArkNat wind shelter at Norra Hällsjön on Etapp 5. Likely a rest/wind shelter, but not necessarily intended as a main overnight stage shelter. Do not assume amenities beyond shelter unless verified.

facilities.name: Källtorpsstugan / Källtorp overnight hut
facilities.coordinateSource: Naturkartan API site 29217; OSM node 3133426887 corroborates nearby.
facilities.description: Endpoint hut/undantagsstuga at Källtorp near Hallingeberg. Official text says sleeping bag is required for overnight use. Name varies: Naturkartan/Västervik text uses Källtorp/Källtorpsstugan; OSM calls it Undantagsstugan Källstorp. Normalize carefully.

facilities.name: Almviks Mathantverk & Matluckan
facilities.coordinateSource: Naturkartan API site 49570; OSM way center agrees within about 10 m.
facilities.description: Cafe/food and unmanned shop service near Almvik/E22. Mentioned by 2026 Tjust practical advice as a service near bus access. Opening hours are seasonal/weather-sensitive and should be checked before user-facing import.

facilities.name: Almviks badplats
facilities.description: Swimming/bathing place near Almvik. Not on the main trail.

facilities.name: Parkering Almviks badplats
facilities.description: Parking by Almviks badplats and nearby Almvik service cluster. Useful for Almvik services/bathing, not a primary trailhead.
